role_title: Senior Product Manager (Onboarding Infra & Agentic Onboarding)

must_have.requirement: 4 to 8 years of product management, with at least 2 years owning a platform, API or infrastructure product.
must_have.evidence_summary: 6+ years in formal PM/SPM roles (Byju's July 2020–April 2023; Lowe's India Sep 2024–Present) plus earlier internal tooling/product roles at Byju's (2015–2020), owning enterprise reliability, asset lifecycle, and AI procurement platforms at Lowe's.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly meets total PM tenure and platform/infrastructure product ownership via Lowe's India.

must_have.requirement: Own platform reliability (SLOs, incident load, support tickets caused by system issues), observability triage, and workflow orchestration.
must_have.evidence_summary: Ensured 99.99% reliability for key business platforms at Lowe's India, defined roadmaps targeting 20% reduction in incident volume, and led automated recovery systems and incident handling workflows saving ~$10M annually.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Direct match on platform reliability, SLA/escalation workflows, and incident load reduction.

must_have.requirement: Reads and writes API specs (REST, OpenAPI), designs service contracts, and reviews tech specs on data models, state transitions, idempotency, retries, and eventual consistency.
must_have.evidence_summary: While holding a B.Tech. in CSE (L325-L328) and owning enterprise workflow platforms at Lowe's (L65-L100), canonical_master_profile.md does not document authoring REST/OpenAPI specs, idempotency/retry state machines, or distributed systems architecture specs.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Per AGENTS.md Gate 6 rules, never fabricate API spec or distributed-systems architecture ownership on the CV; in interviews, discuss high-level workflow orchestration and partner engineering alignment.

must_have.requirement: Turn regulation into system design with Compliance, Legal and Risk: RBI KYC directions, CKYC, and the DPDP Act; know PII handling, encryption, access control, and data vaulting.
must_have.evidence_summary: canonical_master_profile.md explicitly notes under L655 that privacy, consent, and regulatory compliance are not currently evidenced, and contains no RBI KYC, CKYC, DPDP Act, or PII vaulting experience.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Strict Gap; do not claim KYC, DPDP, or PII vaulting experience.

must_have.requirement: Has shipped or prototyped with LLMs and agents: tool calling, agent orchestration, evals and guardrails; fluent in SQL.
must_have.evidence_summary: Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog system (20% cycle time reduction) and automated recovery workflows at Lowe's India, and analyzed funnel/engagement data across roles, but does not document LLM tool-calling APIs, evals, or hands-on SQL query authoring.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Present Lowe's AI-driven procurement and automated recovery workflows honestly as enterprise AI workflow orchestration without inventing LLM tool-calling APIs or eval frameworks.

preferred.requirement: Engineering foundation: degree in CS/Engineering and ideally 2+ years as a software engineer or solutions architect before moving into product.
preferred.evidence_summary: Holds a B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (2011–2015) and built interactive learning prototypes and UX journeys at Byju's (2015–2020), though did not hold a formal Software Engineer or Solutions Architect title.
preferred.positioning_bridge: Highlight B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering and early technical product prototyping foundation.

preferred.requirement: Fintech, payments, banking, lending, identity (OAuth, SSO, OTP), or India KYC stack (CKYC, video KYC, DigiLocker, PAN, GSTIN, Udyam) experience.
preferred.evidence_summary: No fintech, payments, RBI audit, OAuth/SSO identity, or India KYC stack experience exists in canonical_master_profile.md (and AGENTS.md explicitly prohibits fabricating OAuth/security architecture).
preferred.positioning_bridge: Acknowledge fintech/KYC/identity domain gap; emphasize founder experience (Hype Marketing & Product Services, L119-L122) and high-reliability enterprise workflow execution.

preferred.requirement: Founder or early-stage experience building from zero.
preferred.evidence_summary: Founder of Hype Marketing & Product Services (Oct 2023–Nov 2024), building GTM, growth, lifecycle marketing, and digital learning product strategies for multiple clients.
preferred.positioning_bridge: Directly highlight Founder experience and 0-to-1 product launches at Byju's and Lowe's.

implicit.requirement: Pick and manage external verification partners against SLA-backed contracts on coverage, accuracy, latency, uptime, and cost.
implicit.evidence_summary: Managed SLA and escalation workflows, 99.99% platform reliability, and AI-driven procurement and asset lifecycle systems ($2M cost savings) at Lowe's India, though not specifically for KYC verification bureaus.
implicit.positioning_bridge: Bridge from enterprise procurement, asset lifecycle cost optimization, and SLA governance at Lowe's.

domain.requirement: Regulated Fintech Merchant Onboarding, Identity Verification (KYC/AML), and Payments Compliance.
domain.evidence_summary: No fintech, merchant onboarding, KYC/AML, or RBI regulatory domain experience in canonical_master_profile.md.
domain.positioning_bridge: Material domain gap; mitigate by focusing on high-scale funnel conversion (Byju's 35% conversion lift) and enterprise platform reliability (Lowe's 99.99% uptime).
